error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The interface hit an unexpected error. Your display was not changed.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your looks, crosshairs, resolutions and profiles, stored on your PC.
items: Color looks, crosshairs, resolutions and profiles in one place
Search and filter by game
Share with a text code (over Discord or WhatsApp) and import a friend's
Everything stays on your PC: no account and no servers

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.subtitle: Stretched resolution, refresh rate and HDR, with automatic rollback.
items: Current mode of each monitor: resolution, Hz, scaling and HDR
4:3, 5:4 and 16:10 stretched presets computed for your monitor
Custom resolution builder
Countdown: if you don't confirm, it goes back on its own
Hotkey to switch between native and stretched resolution

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.subtitle: What your monitor lets you adjust in hardware.
items: Details for each screen: model, GPU, HDR and scale
Hardware brightness and contrast (DDC/CI) on compatible monitors
Per-monitor gamma and warmth

customize.title: Customize
customize.subtitle: Make VRes look the way you like.
items: Interface themes
Background with your own image or GIF
Window opacity

crosshair.title: Crosshair
crosshair.subtitle: An overlay crosshair, drawn on the screen and not inside the game.
items: Transparent window that doesn't intercept clicks
Shape by parts, size, thickness, gap, outline, color and opacity
Crosshair from your own image
Presets, saved designs, history and share code
Option to hide it from recordings and streams

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Each game with its own setup, applied automatically when it opens.
items: Per-game profile: look, crosshair, resolution and tools
Detects Fortnite, VALORANT, CS2, Apex Legends, Rust and Rainbow Six Siege
When you leave the game, everything goes back to how it was
Add any other game in two clicks

enhancers.title: Dark Boost & Zoom
enhancers.subtitle: Tools to see better in specific moments.
items: Dark Boost: lifts the shadows while you hold a key
1.5× to 4× zoom while you hold a key or a mouse button
They pause on their own when you leave the game
Off by default: some games may consider them an advantage

more.title: More
more.subtitle: Language, updates and information about VRes.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: VRes checks GitHub for new versions. It's the only internet connection it makes.
updates.onlyInApp: Only available in the installed app.

safety.title: If something looks wrong
safety.description: When you close VRes, your display goes back to how it was. The Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R shortcut resets it at any time, even with the window closed, just like “Reset display” in the tray.

about.title: About
about.license: Free software under the GPL-3.0 license. No account and no telemetry.

startup.title: Startup
startup.description: VRes starts with Windows straight to the tray, without opening the window, and applies your last look.
startup.label: Start with Windows

display.title: Display
display.subtitle: Saturation and fine color tuning, monitor by monitor.
display.compareHint: Hold to see the original image
display.resetHint: Sets every value back to neutral

targets.title: Apply to
targets.description: Unticked monitors keep their own colors.
targets.partial: Some monitors are unticked: saturation is paused, because Windows applies it to the whole desktop at once. Fine tuning still applies to the ticked monitors.
targets.none: No monitors are ticked: changes are paused.

saturation.title: Saturation
saturation.hint: 100 is the image as it ships

fineTune.title: Fine tuning
fineTune.description: Applied per monitor, on top of each one's calibration.

display.resetParam: Double-click to go back to neutral
display.emergency: If something looks wrong: Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R resets the display at any time.
display.unavailable: The VRes engine is not available.

reasons.hdrActive: HDR is on: fine tuning doesn't apply on this monitor.
reasons.partialTargets: Paused because some monitors are unticked.
reasons.exclusiveFullscreen: A game in exclusive full screen doesn't show this layer. Use borderless windowed.
reasons.magConflict: Another app (for example, Magnifier or Windows color filters) is using the color filter.
reasons.rampOutOfRange: The requested curve exceeds what Windows allows: the closest one was applied.
reasons.rampRejected: Windows rejected fine tuning on this monitor.
reasons.rampConflict: Another app (Night light, f.lux, a calibrator) is changing this monitor's colors.
reasons.vibranceBackendMissing: This monitor has no driver vibrance.
reasons.vibranceApproximated: Saturation is approximated with driver vibrance.
reasons.displayGone: The display is no longer connected.
reasons.notInGame: Only works with the game in the foreground.
reasons.modeNotSupported: The monitor doesn't support that mode.
reasons.safeModeAfterCrash: Safe mode after an unexpected shutdown.

notices.recovered: VRes didn't close properly last time: it already restored the original colors.
notices.safeMode: For safety, VRes started with color turned off. Turn it on whenever you like.
notices.emergencyReset: Display reset: color is now off.
notices.hotkeyTaken: Another program uses Ctrl + Alt + Shift + R, so the emergency shortcut isn't available. You can reset the display from the tray.
notices.engineUnavailable: The VRes engine couldn't start. Restart the app; if it keeps happening, please report it.
